segment_contamination_dimensions: Log Homes (sibling MCAT 32367) and Log Cabin (sibling MCAT 108654) carve out the log-construction sub-segment; enhanced names and alt names must not position this MCAT as exclusively a log home or log cabin product — terms like 'log home' and 'log cabin' are retained only as secondary alt-name entries, not as primary enhanced name tokens.

Prefabricated Wooden House (sibling MCAT 88198) is a near-identical sibling; enhanced names must not replicate its exact name — 'Prefabricated Wooden House' as a standalone four-word phrase is blocked from enhanced_name_4w to avoid direct collision.

Portable House (sibling MCAT 88195), Portable Resort (sibling MCAT 183544), and Portable Huts (sibling MCAT 164685) carve out the relocatable/portable buyer segment; enhanced names must not use 'portable' as a descriptor, as that buyer segment (temporary, relocatable structures) is incompatible with the permanent residential and resort-installation buyer persona of this MCAT.
Bamboo Huts (sibling MCAT 141758) carves out the bamboo-material sub-segment; no bamboo-specific terms are introduced into enhanced names or alt names.

Bunkhouses, MS Bunkhouse, Prefab Steel Bunk House, and Bunk House Office siblings carve out the labour/worker accommodation buyer segment (industrial site operators, contractors housing workers); enhanced names must not use 'bunkhouse' or signal worker-camp accommodation, as that buyer persona is incompatible with the residential/resort buyer of this MCAT.
